topic.title: FIT Boot

body.p: BIOS is required to support FIT boot, which allows the microcode updates being loaded on every logical processors in the package before executing the first BIOS instruction at the reset vector. This is a significant advantage for the processor to correct any critical errata before the code in BIOS is executed. Refer to Firmware Interface Table BIOS Specification for FIT implementation details.

At this point, the microcode update content that requires system memory being available will not apply. Therefore, the BIOS must reload the microcode update (i.e. load the same version of microcode update again) to all logical processors after memory initialization is completed. Note that BIOS should only include 1 Microcode Update per processor stepping.
